name: TMS_DEPART_TO_PAST
meaning: moves to Ralph, bull home, Wolf freeze + msg 0x39, anim 0; at anim end SwapToPast then swap when g_gameFlags & 0x4000

name: TMS_WAIT_RETURN
meaning: hum 0xCD, anim 5; waits for Ralph to leave and re-enter the ±0xB9 cube (not during cinematics), then calls followers with msg 0x38

name: TMS_GATHER_FOLLOWERS
meaning: Wolf frozen; waits up to 3000 ms (g_dtMs) for Dragon/Gossamer to enter the cube

name: TMS_DEPART_TO_PRESENT
meaning: anim 6; at anim end SwapToPresent + swap when 0x4000
